citations.description: Ticket last comment: 'LIVE RUN 30637886718 (main @ 40acae563, J9 merged) — THE FIX WORKS. ... The counts were again 2 failed, 12 passed, 1 error — IDENTICAL to the two previous runs — but the CAUSE changed completely.' The two named tests (test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing, test_a_dc_created_ticket_carries_the_shared_jira_provenance) are in the 'failed' bucket.

findings.criterion: [operator-attested] a full writing reconcile pass (bootstrap-strict) against the J5 harness converges with no unhandled exception — covering tests test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing and test_a_dc_created_ticket_carries_the_shared_jira_provenance both pass
findings.detail: The only concrete attestation in the ticket is the last comment referencing live run 30637886718 (main @ 40acae563). That comment explicitly states the test counts were '2 failed, 12 passed, 1 error' — meaning the two named tests did NOT pass in that run. The comment explains the failures were due to a test defect in _envelope() that was then corrected in the oracle file, but no subsequent run attestation is recorded showing the corrected tests passing. The ticket remains in_progress. The attestation names a specific run id and outcome, but the outcome is a failure, not a pass — so the criterion is not met.
findings.remediation: Record a ticket comment citing a CI run id/URL where both test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing and test_a_dc_created_ticket_carries_the_shared_jira_provenance pass (exit 0, no Traceback in stderr, convergence line on stdout). The oracle corrections are already in place; a new harness run is needed to produce the passing attestation.
